# S-01 — SPDX License List (fixture reading note)
accessed: 2026-09-18 · tier: T1 (published standard) · depth: full

## Findings
- MIT and BSD-3-Clause are SPDX-listed, OSI-approved identifiers; all three candidate stacks'
  direct dependencies declare one of them (checked against deps.dev declared licences).

## Limitations
- The list identifies licences; it does not determine which licence a given package actually
  ships (ClearlyDefined declared-vs-discovered was used for that).

## Verbatim quotes
- "isOsiApproved: true" (licenses.json entries for MIT, BSD-3-Clause)
